pairs.why: The two are almost identical, but in B the flame's warm glow lights the cage bars and base, which matches the warm, lit-from-inside look of the real oil lamp and street lamp better than A's flat, cold metal.
This is the same pair as q000 with the sides swapped: A has the warm glow on the cage and base, while B's dark metal looks flatter and colder than the real lamp cards.
A has a soft wood grain on the rim and spokes, like the real wood cards, while B's smooth orange looks like plastic, the 'statue' look the lessons rejected.
This is the same pair as q002 with the sides swapped: B's soft wood grain reads as real wood, while A's plain orange looks like a plastic toy.
A's thin stitched pattern reads as real boot leather, like the stitched saddles the lessons preferred, while B's bold, raised yellow shapes look like a plastic toy decal.
This is the same pair as q004 with the sides swapped: B's stitched leather detail fits the real cards better than A's bold, raised yellow inlay.
A has stitched edges and a slight leather grain, like the saddles the lessons preferred, while B's smooth, seamless glossy leather moves toward the rejected 'statue' finish.
This is the same pair as q006 with the sides swapped: B has the stitching and leather grain, while A is the seamless, glossy, statue-like version.
